meta.name: product-launch-video
meta.description: Turn a product or marketing URL, pasted script, or brief into a product launch / promo video — SaaS promos, feature reveals, product demos, app and company launches. Use when the user wants to market, launch, promote, or reveal a product; the default for any commercial URL. Site tours / showcases of a website route here too — the brief carries the show-it-as-is intent. Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将产品链接或脚本自动转为宣传视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要制作产品发布或推广视频
copy.tagline_en: Turn a product link or script into a promo video automatically
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to create product launch or promotional videos

howto.what: 将产品链接、脚本或简介转化为宣传视频。它会抓取品牌素材、设计视觉风格、编写分镜脚本，并逐帧生成动画，最终输出视频。
howto.when: 当你提供产品/营销链接、粘贴脚本或简要描述，并希望制作宣传视频时触发。也适用于网站导览/展示。

say.text: 根据这段脚本，生成一个产品发布视频。
say.note: 技能会使用你提供的脚本作为旁白。

say.text: 给我的网站做个导览视频：https://example.com
say.note: 技能会捕获网站截图并制作展示视频。

howto.what_en: Turns a product URL, pasted script, or brief into a launch/promo video. It captures brand assets, designs a visual style, writes a storyboard and script, generates frames with animation, and renders a final video.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you provide a product/marketing URL, pasted script, or brief and want a promotional video. Also works for site tours/showcases.

say_en.text: Make a promo video for this product: https://example.com/product
say_en.note: The skill will scrape the URL and start production.

say_en.text: Generate a product launch video from this script.
say_en.note: The skill uses your script as voiceover.

say_en.text: Create a site tour video for https://example.com
say_en.note: The skill captures screenshots and makes a showcase.
